dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius; obtuse shape classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width is approximately 1.6 times the maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, broad convexity with a large radius arc fitting the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum extending from the melon; length is approximately 0.4 times the melon's vertical height in this aspect.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Approximately 135 degrees where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear mark on the dorsal-cranial surface; multiple small, circular pale epidermal spots on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced tri-color pigmentation pattern featuring a dark dorsal cape, a lighter grey flank transition, and a white ventral field.
